# VidFlow - Universal Video Downloader
> Free online video downloader supporting YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok, Twitter, Instagram — 1,000+ platforms.
> Features AI video summarization, mind map generation, and subtitle extraction.
> Paste a link, download anything. No registration, no ads, completely free.

## Quick Facts
- URL: https://vidflow.cn
- Type: Web Application (SPA)
- Language: zh-CN / English (toggle in header)
- Platforms supported: 1,000+ (YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, TikTok, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Vimeo, etc.)
- Key features: HD video download, AI summarization, mind map generation, subtitle extraction (SRT)
- Price: Free, no registration required
- AI engine: DeepSeek (deepseek-chat model)

## How VidFlow Works
1. Paste any video URL (YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok, Twitter…)
2. Click "Parse" — VidFlow fetches video info and available formats
3. Select your preferred quality (360P to 4K, or audio-only MP3)
4. Choose download mode: Server (stable) or Direct (fast)
5. Click "Download" — watch real-time progress via WebSocket

## Site Map
- [Home](https://vidflow.cn): Main application — paste video link, download video, AI summarize
- [llms-full.txt](https://vidflow.cn/llms-full.txt): Full site content in markdown for LLM consumption
- [robots.txt](https://vidflow.cn/robots.txt): Crawler directives
- [sitemap.xml](https://vidflow.cn/sitemap.xml): URL listing for search engines

## For AI Crawlers
- robots.txt: https://vidflow.cn/robots.txt
- sitemap.xml: https://vidflow.cn/sitemap.xml
- Structured data (JSON-LD): SoftwareApplication, Organization, FAQPage, WebApplication
